big_case.notes: The staged application seeks narrow preservation of an individual bankruptcy-related recusal controversy during Fourth Circuit rehearing. Its broader constitutional allegations do not establish systemwide relief or a precedential ruling; the recorded disposition is an individual Circuit Justice denial.

leakage.notes: All 31 logged calls occurred November 9, before this application's November 11 denial. The corpus query was restricted to decisions before 2026; CourtListener supplied historical Hollingsworth material. The two unobserved web calls targeted that historical authority, not this application's disposition. Their missing results are not evidence of empty retrieval. Neither the queries nor the prose reveals this event's outcome.
